item.title: Natural gas leak prompts Seattle neighborhood evacuations
item.description: Firefighters in Seattle went door to door evacuating residents in at least 10 homes following reports of a natural gas leak in a neighborhood near the Central District.

item.title: 18-year-old shot and killed in Pierce County, WA
item.description: A teenager is dead, and law enforcement is hunting for a suspect this weekend following a shooting in Pierce County.

item.title: Seattle weather: Cooler showers by Monday
item.description: For Sunday, expect a couple of showers with morning clouds and some afternoon sun breaks for parts of the region.

item.title: Kalani Kossa-Rienzi scores lone goal in Seattle Sounders 1-0 win over St. Louis City
item.description: Defender Kalani Kossa-Rienzi scored two minutes into the second half and Andrew Thomas made it stand up as the Seattle Sounders edged St, Louis City SC 1-0 on Saturday night.

item.title: Seattle Kraken blown out in 7-4 home loss to Senators
item.description: Shane Pinto had a goal and two assists in Ottawa's four-goal spree in the first and second periods and the Senators beat the Seattle Kraken 7-4 on Saturday night.

item.title: Seattle weather: Heavy mountain snow on Sunday
item.description: With colder air arriving during the work week, during the early morning or evening hours — when a mix of moisture and near-freezing temperatures produces a rain-snow mix in the lowlands.

item.title: Dozens rally against WA ‘millionaires tax’ bill in Olympia
item.description: With just days left of the Washington legislative session, a couple dozen people rallied against the proposed millionaires tax over the weekend, FOX 13 spoke with attendees about their concerns.

item.title: Lynnwood, WA mayor releases statement following shooting of high school student
item.description: The mayor of Lynnwood has released a statement following the shooting of a local high school student last week, saying the community needs to root out youth violence.

item.title: Seattle weather: Rain/snow mix this week
item.description: The bigger story is in the mountains. A winter weather advisory remains in effect today for Stevens Pass and Mount Baker, where snow will be falling.

item.title: 2 Seattle women stranded in Dubai amid Iran conflict return home
item.description: A family is back home in Seattle, after they were stranded in the United Arab Emirates for six days. Their trip was unexpectedly extended, as the conflict in Iran continues escalating.
